snippet.title: Dodo Duckie - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Dodo Duckie is AVAILABLE NOW on Steam, Epic games, XBOX Series X|S + Windows.

Waddle into a reality-bending odyssey where simply being a duck is your greatest superpower. With the help of your magical cap, switch instantly between 2D and 3D to uncover hidden paths, outsmart aliens, and rescue your kidnapped chicken friends in this wholesome puzzle platformer adventure. Dodo Duckie is coming to Xbox!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3358170/Dodo_Duckie/
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/dodo-duckie/9p7s9f02293j 
Epic Games: https://store.epicgames.com/p/dodo-duckie-01f071

____________________________________________________________

🎙️Voiced By: Billie Fulford-Brown 
🎵Music by : Richard Stevens
____________________________________________________________
